column2: you need two other instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard to cast it as though it had flash
column3: Outdated: dated 2018-12-07 (the Ultimate Masters Release Notes, 2018-11-29), written under CR 601.3 as worded in the CRs effective 2016-07-22 to 2019-08-23 (“If that player is no longer allowed to cast that spell after completing its proposal, the casting of the spell is illegal ...”; 601.4 from the CR effective 2019-10-04, now 601.6): with the card on the stack once its proposal is complete, one other card no longer met the condition. The CR effective 2022-04-29 (Streets of New Capenna) added 601.4a, now 601.6a: “Once a player has begun casting a spell that had flash because certain conditions were met or that could be cast as though it had flash because certain conditions were met (see 601.3d), they may continue to cast that spell as though it had flash even if those conditions stop being met.” (archived CR texts). The card counts itself as the casting begins, as Graveyard Shift's ruling of 2022-04-29 has Graveyard Shift do, so one other instant or sorcery card is enough (tests/rulings/r_residue_misc_1_stack.rs, swift_reckoning_cast_from_the_graveyard_counts_itself_as_casting_begins; register flash-permission-conditions-judged-as-casting-begins); logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md
